title: Low-Cost Decision Making for Group of Vehicles for Safe Mobility in V2X
summary: TCS is researching low-cost decision making for vehicle groups. Safer traffic and lower fuel use remain intended benefits of the simulated approach.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: TCS is researching low-cost decision making for vehicle groups through virtual simulations. Safer traffic and lower fuel use remain intended benefits.
purpose: Coordinate connected vehicles for safer and more efficient movement.
system: AI vehicle-group decision-making framework for V2X

ratings.reason: Road users are intended to gain safety and convenience; no crash or journey outcome is demonstrated.
Fleet operators are intended to improve efficiency; no real fleet gain is recorded.
Lower emissions and congestion are intended, not measured in live traffic.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 4: Low-Cost Decision Making for Group of Vehicles for Safe Mobility in V2X

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: Vehicle-group simulation data and coordinated communication

headline: Simulating coordinated vehicle decisions
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
